luiskr.com / core/utils/dom / flushLayout

function flushLayout(el): number

Defined in: core/utils/dom.ts:258

Deliberate synchronous layout flush — the ONE sanctioned forced reflow. Used by the transition-restart pattern: write classes/styles, force layout so the browser commits them, then apply the animating class in the same frame. Callers get the element's offsetHeight as a side effect of the flush; the return value is meant to be ignored (void).

Parameters

el

HTMLElement

Element whose layout is flushed.

Returns

number

the element's offsetHeight (the flushing read).
